title: Improving and Balancing Task Allocation with Market Design
abstract: arXiv:2607.23222v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In balanced task allocation, a firm allocates stochastically arriving tasks to workers. Balance requires that workers complete the same number of tasks or have equally difficult task allocations. Prominently, U.S. foster care agencies rotate allocation across workers to satisfy balance. The Rotation mechanism is highly inefficient and could contribute to poorer welfare and productivity for workers. I take a market design approach to construct the Dynamic Pseudomarket Mechanism (DPM). It satisfies the institutional balance constraint, Pareto efficiency, and approximate incentive compatibility. I develop a data-driven bound on DPM's expected productivity because DPM could increase or decrease productivity in practice. Simulation results indicate this approach can accurately predict DPM's effects with minimal data. translated_title: 用市场设计改进与平衡任务分配
translated_abstract: 在平衡任务分配问题中，企业需要将随机到达的任务分配给工人。平衡性要求工人完成相同数量的任务，或承担难度相当的任务分配。一个突出的例子是，美国的寄养服务机构通过在员工之间轮换分配任务来满足平衡要求。然而，这种轮换机制的效率极低，可能导致工人的福利和生产力下降。本文采用市场设计方法构建了动态伪市场机制。该机制满足制度性平衡约束、帕累托效率以及近似激励相容性。由于DPM在实践中可能提高也可能降低生产力，作者开发了一种基于数据的DPM预期生产力界限估计方法。仿真结果表明，该方法能够以极少量数据准确预测DPM的实际效果。支撑该界限的理论结果证明，在大型随机市场中，工人的福利会收敛于……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出动态伪市场机制（DPM）来替代低效的轮换式任务分配机制，在满足平衡约束、帕累托效率和近似激励相容的同时，可通过极少数据准确预测其对生产力的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Dynamic Pseudomarket Mechanism (DPM) to replace inefficient rotation-based task allocation, which satisfies balance constraints, Pareto efficiency, and approximate incentive compatibility, while enabling accurate prediction of its productivity effects with minimal data.
